mechanism: Primaquine can cause hemolytic anemia and methemoglobinemia, which may precipitate acute renal failure in patients on irbesartan; additionally, both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism with potential for altered clearance.
action: Monitor renal function, hemoglobin/hematocrit, and methemoglobin levels closely; assess G6PD deficiency status before primaquine use; consider alternative antimalarial if renal impairment develops.
